decision.rationale: An independent implementation that imports none of M394, M381, M339 or M43 rehashed all 80 M40 payloads and rebuilt all 17,280 H67 ep35/no-running phases. Every population, 28-point command/SRAM sweep row and six-point blocking row matches M394 exactly. The cmd32/L8 point independently reproduces 742,148,386 baseline cycles, 669,012,336 candidate cycles and 1.1093194341337227x. This clears the frozen >=1.05 module gate and authorizes an H67 real-trace RTL cycle miter, but does not authorize RTL-measured, system, energy, physical-SRAM, paper-PPA or headline claims.

independent_recompute.method: Direct little-endian unpack of the frozen positive bit plane, explicit valid-pad 3x3 taps in channel-major feature order, independent uint16 popcount LUT q32 selector, independent exact residual reconstruction and local cycle recurrence.

q32_semantic_hammer.tie_rule: best index changes only for distance < best_distance; an equal distance preserves the lower index

robust_point.scope: H67 ep35/no-running S10, four bottleneck Conv3x3 modules

comparison_only.interpretation: The PAFT value is a separate-population exploratory comparator and contributes no rows or cycles to the H67 result.

findings.title: The accepted number is a four-Conv trace-cycle estimate
findings.detail: 1.1093194341x covers the four 768-channel bottleneck Conv3x3 modules only. It is neither a full-network nor an Amdahl-adjusted system speedup.

findings.title: The H67 real-trace RTL cycle miter is still pending
findings.detail: Matcher timing, phase sealing, DMA handshakes, descriptor SRAM responses, two replays and tail-state accounting have not yet been reconciled against VCS over all 17,280 phases.

findings.title: The baseline remains a cycle-model oracle
findings.detail: The bit-sparse baseline is independently reproduced under the same frozen recurrence, but no matched-frequency baseline RTL/netlist establishes a physical throughput ratio.

findings.title: Physical memory and energy are outside this evidence
findings.detail: Descriptor and PWP memories, DRAM behavior and backend service remain modeled. No SRAM macro, SPEF, SAIF/PTPX or energy-per-inference result is admitted.

findings.title: Runtime representativeness remains limited
findings.detail: The frozen runtime population is ten samples from zurich_city_09_a. The train-only catalog spans 18 sequences without validation leakage, but the module-cycle ratio still needs sequence and density stratification before a broad paper claim.

next_gate.name: M393_H67_REALTRACE_RTL_CYCLE_MITER
mandatory_pass_conditions: zero q32 tie-break or strict-use mismatch
reconciled H67 four-Conv speedup remains at least 1.05x
negative_controls: one extra blocking cycle per replayed descriptor must reduce the modeled ratio below 1.05x
early replay0 before tile0 completion must fail
one changed center run address/length must fail
one reordered descriptor response must fail
